description: This file defines functions and types related to web search provider resolution, configuration, and execution within a larger application. It manages provider listing, credential handling, and search definition resolution.

methods.name: resolveSearchConfig
methods.description: Resolves the web search configuration from the provided OpenClawConfig object.

methods.name: resolveWebSearchEnabled
methods.description: Determines if web search is enabled based on configuration and sandbox status.

methods.name: listWebSearchProviders
methods.description: Returns a list of available web search providers, including bundled ones.

methods.name: listConfiguredWebSearchProviders
methods.description: Returns a list of web search providers configured in the current environment.

methods.name: resolveWebSearchProviderId
methods.description: Determines the appropriate web search provider ID based on configuration, credentials, and available providers.

methods.name: resolveWebSearchDefinition
methods.description: Resolves the web search provider and its definition based on current configuration and preferences.

methods.name: runWebSearch
methods.description: Executes a web search using the resolved provider and returns the result.
